question: What results from resorting to various distinct things?
premises: Having resorted to various distinct things, they go to variegated cognizer-hood.
Rootedness is in this natural infinite varṇa-consciousness.
inference: Resorting to distinct things leads to variegated cognizer-hood, while rootedness belongs to natural infinite varṇa-consciousness.
uncertainties: The exact referent of 'various distinct' is not specified.
The precise syntactic relation of 'of this' to the preceding clause is unclear.
plain_english: Having resorted to various distinct things, they attain variegated cognizer-hood; rootedness is in this natural, infinite consciousness of varṇas.
